experiences.description:
• Review Request for Service (RFS) from the client and Identify the severity of the RFS
• Assess the details of the RFS with Solution Architect and determine IBM Towers / team involvement to perform the tasks
• Assist Solution Architect in the creation of Architect Design Overview (ADO) document for Solution Charter (SC)
• Coordinate IBM towers to identified Subject matter experts (SMEs) and their efforts to complete the charter
• Setup solution meetings to identify roles and responsibilities of each tower / team and obtain their respective quotes.
• Use various financial tools to obtain price for the charter and perform QA Value analysis
• Prepare the Solution Charter (SC) to highlight Scope, assumptions, risks, deliverable, ADO and embed the labor cost, time & material etc.
• Request the approval of a Price Release Letter (PRL) in the case of negative billing or retro credit to the client from the Project Executive (PEs) and complete risks.
• Complete the RFS Response & Update RFS Tool with proposal documents and approvals 
• Upon approval from final QA reviewer submit Solution Charter (SC) to RFS Administrator for their further submission to the client

Manage IT Projects to support multi-disciplines in project management, engineering, procurement, and construction and to enable multi-office project executions in Toronto, Calgary, Edmonton, and Montreal

•	Provided IS&T related orientation to the new hires.
•	Performed monthly audit for the users’ accounts in Active Directory and their membership.
•	Communicated with the project IT leads to understand client’s requirement and facilitate their need accordingly.
•	Organized lunch and learns within the department to share knowledge and problem resolution.
•	Arranged and conducted brown bags sessions to educate users in their daily IT business needs.
•	Led and Managed a team of 8 people of Helpdesk/ Desktop, Network and Audio Visual to ensure smooth IT operations/ Infrastructure in Toronto, Sarnia and Montreal locations.
•	Configured Nortel switches 450s, 470s to setup VLAN to accommodate business needs.
•	Upgraded and Configured old model Nortel Switches to PoE switches (5520) to accommodate i2002 Nortel VoIP phones for Toronto users.
•	Brought an extension of Calgary helpdesk services (ACD phones) to Toronto.
•	Provided after hours and before hours helpdesk coverage to the Calgary, Edmonton users.
•	Configured the helpdesk ACD phones to ensure 99.9% uptime or warm body response from the helpdesk personnel.
•	Upgraded old Dell Power Edge Servers 4600 series to PE 2850 / 2950 after the expiry of their Dell Contract.
